title: MediaSubject
description: MEDIA-01. A saved character, prop or place for consistent use in media. Sharing is private unless explicitly granted to named people. Real people are labelled; subject_age_band is deliberately absent. CREATOR-01 adds the optional person_id link and the locked_description sentence.

shared_to.description: Private to owner unless explicitly shared to these named people.

reference_file_ids.description: Approved Library picture file ids only; never paths.

real.description: Label that the subject represents a real person or place when applicable.

person_id.description: CREATOR-01. Optional person link: the household member this subject was made from their own photos. Casting a household member is governed by generation.household_likeness alone and creates no synth. When set, `real` and the minor fact are derived from that person at read time (the person's age band, so a child who turns eighteen changes without an edit); a reader never trusts the stored `real` over the person, and a writer never stores a minor fact on the subject. Absent or null: the subject is not a household member (a synth-linked subject derives `real` from the synth's based_on instead).

locked_description.description: CREATOR-01. The subject's locked sentence: one description a writer repeats word for word in every prompt that casts this subject. Optional.
